limitations: Well-mixed single population, autonomous logistic susceptible flow and constant transmission/recovery rates.
Prescribed labeled multiplicative pulse factors \(q_i\in(0,1)\), positive gaps, and \(e^{AT}Q>1\).
Fixed pulse multipliers do not equalize the absolute number of vaccinations used by different schedules.
Global nonlinear SIR dynamics, seasonal forcing, spatial couplings and independent publication-priority evaluation are not asserted.
scientific_integrity: An analytic theorem for specified logistic disease-free dynamics. Claims concern invariant linear invasion multiplier and minimax peak, not disease eradication or equal actual vaccine cost.
title: Sharp peak-susceptibility bounds and heterogeneous pulse timing in a logistic vaccination model
